nodes.text:
Mind the sparks.

I sell edges and I fix edges. Bring me a thing that used to cut and I'll tell you whether it can again.

choices.label: Why is half the rack empty?

nodes.text:
Because half of what I make walks into the fen and doesn't walk back. I stock what I can replace.

The good stuff - the pieces I'd be proud of - you'll not buy those from me. You'll take them off something that took them off someone else. That's the honest shape of it.
